periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, angled approximately 45 degrees downward toward the snout relative to the horizontal facial axis
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated teardrop or oval shape with a high length-to-width ratio
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering towards the muzzle

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Relatively flat U-shape across the posterior margin
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band covering approximately one-third of the visible torso

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Distinct gap between the ears, roughly equal to the width of an individual ear
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded semicircular curvature at the apex
